name: Aphelia
notes: Faster, safer browsing on every start. Shields now blocks scam and fake-download pages outright, adds uBlock Origin's malware list, and keeps YouTube and other ad fixes fresh by checking lists every hour. The VPN restarts itself if it stops, lets you pick sites that skip it (in Control), keeps your home network reachable, and tells you if your network is blocking it. When you turn on your PC, Aphelia waits for the machine to settle before loading your other Spaces in the background.
